orders.description: One entry per work order that has been admitted to execution, written by `forge.py dispatch --apply` in the same transaction as the acquisition that earned it. Resume reads this file rather than conversation memory.

procedure.description: How this packet's task class resolved against doctrine/procedures.json. `procedured: false` means no procedure covered it, so its steps, acceptance and evidence were improvised rather than taken from doctrine, and `nearest` names the closest declared task classes because an unresolved class is usually a misspelling of one that exists.

terminal_states.description: The states an order may stop at. An order resting anywhere else is still in flight.
